item.title: firecrawl / pdf-inspector
item.description: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.

item.title: jdx / mise
item.description: dev tools, env vars, task runner

item.title: warp-tech / warpgate
item.description: Fully transparent SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL and Postgres bastion/PAM that doesn't need additional client-side software

item.title: raphamorim / rio
item.description: A hardware-accelerated GPU terminal emulator focusing to run in desktops and browsers.

item.title: FalkorDB / FalkorDB
item.description: A super fast Graph Database uses GraphBLAS under the hood for its sparse adjacency matrix graph representation. Our goal is to provide the best Knowledge Graph for LLM (GraphRAG).

item.title: rustdesk / rustdesk
item.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

item.title: juspay / hyperswitch
item.description: Open source, composable payments platform | PCI compliant | SaaS and Self-host options | Enables connectivity to multiple payment, payout, fraud, vault and tokenization providers | Uplifts authorization with intelligent routing and revenue recovery | Reduce payment processing costs with cost observability | Reduces payment ops with reconciliation

item.title: katanemo / plano
item.description: Plano is an AI-native proxy server and data plane for agentic apps. Smart LLM routing, observability, agent orchestration, and guardrails so you stay focused on your agents core logic.

item.title: getzola / zola
item.description: A fast static site generator in a single binary with everything built-in. https://www.getzola.org

item.title: GCWing / BitFun
item.description: BitFun combines a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust with a polished desktop application. It pairs the depth of a Code Agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development.

item.title: Dicklesworthstone / destructive_command_guard
item.description: The Destructive Command Guard (dcg) is for blocking dangerous git and shell commands from being executed by agents.

item.title: zed-industries / zed
item.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.

item.title: EFForg / rayhunter
item.description: Rust tool to detect cell site simulators on an orbic mobile hotspot

item.title: rtk-ai / rtk
item.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies

item.title: ovexro / dockpanel
item.description: Modern server management panel built with Rust and React. Sites, databases, Docker apps, Git deploy, mail, DNS, monitoring, backups, and security — all in one panel.

item.title: yvgude / lean-ctx
item.description: Control what your AI can see. LeanCTX (Lean Context) is the context intelligence layer for AI agents — one local Rust binary that decides what they read, remembers what they learn, guards what they touch, and proves what they save. 60–90% fewer tokens as the receipt. 76 MCP tools, 30+ agents, local-first.

item.title: tree-sitter / tree-sitter
item.description: An incremental parsing system for programming tools
